[Section] Preliminaries
[source_id=9] Our underlying model architecture is a standard attentional encoder-decoder BIBREF1 . Let INLINEFORM0 and INLINEFORM1 denote the source and target sentences, respectively. We use a Bi-LSTM encoder to represent the source words as a matrix INLINEFORM2 . The conditional probability of the target sentence is given as DISPLAYFORM0
[source_id=10] where INLINEFORM0 is computed by a softmax output layer that receives a decoder state INLINEFORM1 as input. This state is updated by an auto-regressive LSTM, INLINEFORM2 , where INLINEFORM3 is an input context vector. This vector is computed as INLINEFORM4 , where INLINEFORM5 is a probability distribution that represents the attention over the source words, commonly obtained as DISPLAYFORM0
[source_id=11] where INLINEFORM0 is a vector of scores. We follow BIBREF14 and define INLINEFORM1 as a bilinear transformation of encoder and decoder states, where INLINEFORM2 is a model parameter.
